name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
dept: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
benefits: ₹6,000 per year direct income support in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 via DBT.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names. Excludes institutional landholders and constitutional post holders.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership papers (Khata/Khasra), Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar.
process: Apply online via PM-Kisan Portal or CSC centres. Verify e-KYC using OTP or biometric authentication.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
dept: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
benefits: Comprehensive risk insurance covering pre-sowing to post-harvest losses due to natural calamities. Premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticulture.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Non-loanee farmers must provide land records/tenant agreements.
documents: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) / Sowing Certificate, Bank Passbook, Aadhaar Card, Crop insurance declaration.
process: Enroll via bank branch, nearest CSC, National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP) or PMFBY App before cutoff date.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
dept: Department of Agriculture & Cooperation / RBI / NABARD
target: Farmers, Dairy Farmers, Animal Husbandry & Fishermen
benefits: Short-term institutional crop/livestock credit up to ₹3 Lakh at concessional interest rate of 4% (with 3% prompt repayment incentive). Up to ₹1.60 Lakh collateral-free.
eligibility: Individual/joint borrowers, tenant farmers, SHGs, JLGs of farmers and livestock owners.
documents: Duly filled application form, Identity & Address proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Land records, Land cultivation proof.
process: Submit application at any commercial, cooperative or rural bank branch or via PM-Kisan portal single-window KCC link.

name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM)
dept: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, GoI
target: Dairy Farmers, Cattle Breeders, Cooperatives, Entrepreneurs
benefits: Up to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2 Crore) for establishing Breed Multiplication Farms, sexed semen technology, and indigenous bovine development.
eligibility: Individual entrepreneurs, Section 8 companies, FPOs, SHGs, Dairy Cooperatives with land and cattle management infrastructure.
documents: Project DPR, Land ownership/lease deed (minimum 3 acres), Aadhaar/PAN, Bank loan sanction letter.
process: Apply online through National Livestock Mission (NLM) / DAHD portal with detailed project proposal and bank approval.

name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Fund (AHIDF)
dept: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, GoI
target: Dairy Processing Units, Meat Processing, Animal Feed Plants
benefits: 3% interest subvention on bank loan up to 90% project cost, with credit guarantee coverage up to 25% from NABARD/Credit Guarantee Fund.
eligibility: Dairy cooperatives, FPOs, MSMEs, Private Companies, Individual Entrepreneurs in dairy & feed manufacturing.
documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR), MSME registration / Udyam, Bank KYC, Financial statements for existing businesses.
process: Submit online application with DPR on AHIDF portal (ahidf.udyamimitra.in). Evaluated by Project Sanctioning Committee.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana — Per Drop More Crop
dept: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
benefits: 45% to 55% financial subsidy for installing Drip Irrigation and Sprinkler systems, reducing water use by up to 40% while boosting yield.
eligibility: Farmers of all categories having cultivable land with an assured water source (borewell/canal/pond).
documents: Land revenue records (7/12, Khasra-Khatauni), Aadhaar Card, Water source certificate, Bank passbook.
process: Register on State Horticulture / Agriculture portal or apply through District Horticulture Officer (DHO).

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
benefits: Direct financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh (plain areas) / ₹1.30 Lakh (hilly areas) for building a pucca house + 90 days MGNREGA labor wages + ₹12,000 toilet subsidy.
eligibility: Households registered in SECC 2011 / Awaas+ list without pucca house, landless laborers, vulnerable families.
documents: Aadhaar, Job Card number, Bank Account linked to Aadhaar, Gram Sabha verification.
process: Identification by Gram Panchayat and Block Development Officer. Payments released in stages via Direct Benefit Transfer.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
dept: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
target: Small, Marginal and Women Farmers, Custom Hiring Centres
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy on procurement of tractors, power tillers, rotavators, seed drills, and harvesters. Up to 80% subsidy for village Custom Hiring Centres.
eligibility: Individual farmers, cooperative societies, SHGs, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs).
documents: Aadhaar Card, Land Record documents, Bank passbook, Quotation from authorized machinery dealer.
process: Apply online via Agri Machinery portal (agrimachinery.nic.in) and select approved manufacturer/dealer.

name: Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana (MKSP)
target: Rural Women Farmers and SHG Members
benefits: Capacity building, training in sustainable agriculture, drudgery-reducing farm tools, organic input production support, and market linkage.
eligibility: Women smallholders, women agricultural laborers, and members of Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-NRLM Self Help Groups.
documents: SHG membership passbook, Aadhaar card, Village Organization recommendation.
process: Enrollment through Village Level SHG Federations and Block Resource Centers (NRLM).

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
dept: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
benefits: Free comprehensive soil testing card issued every 2 years containing nutrient status (N, P, K, micro-nutrients) and crop-wise fertilizer dosage recommendations.
documents: Khasra/Khatauni land record number, Farmer mobile number, Soil sample collected by village representative.
process: Soil samples collected by local agriculture field officers or submitted at Block Soil Testing Laboratories.
